findings.title: Dry-run writes can escape through copied symlinks
findings.description: `copyInstallPaths` uses `fs.cpSync` with `verbatimSymlinks: true`. If an install directory such as `.claude`, `.github`, or a nested rules directory is a symlink, the sandbox receives a symlink with the same target. `installTarget` subsequently writes through that link, so an absolute link can modify the real project or another external directory during a supposedly non-writing dry run. Relative links can likewise resolve outside the sandbox. Since `regularFilesUnder` ignores symlinks, the resulting mutation may also be omitted from the change report. Materialize copied content into non-symlink sandbox paths or explicitly reject unsafe symlinks, with tests for absolute and relative links.

findings.title: The lint port requires a Ruff baseline absent from the production guide
findings.description: The no-Ruff-config branch eagerly evaluates `fs.readFileSync(this.source('python', 'ruff.toml'))` before calling `writeOrSuggest`. The checked-in guide at `project-documents/ai-project-guide/project-guides/lint/python/` contains only `required`; it has no `ruff.toml`. Consequently, any detected Python project without an existing Ruff configuration fails with `ENOENT` and exits 1—even in report-only mode. The fixture guide supplies a baseline file that the actual installed guide does not contain, so this production failure is currently masked.

findings.title: Dry-run aborts discard the buffered diagnostic
findings.description: The sandbox install is invoked before the buffered stdout is replayed. If the install throws `InstallAbort`, execution never reaches the replay loop, and `installIde` catches the abort outside `dryRunInstall`. Errors written through the buffered `Printer`, such as the missing lint-directory message from `checkLintConfigs`, are therefore discarded, leaving only the generic “setup-ide failed” message. Replay the captured diagnostics when the install aborts, or report abort details through stderr.

findings.title: The fixture-only Ruff baseline hides the production failure
findings.description: `PYTHON_BASELINE` is loaded from `fixture_guide/lint/python/ruff.toml`, a file that exists only in the fixture. The real-guide smoke test does not create a Python project or exercise `--write-lint`, so every lint test passes while the production guide cannot supply the required baseline. Add a lint case using the installed guide with a Python marker file and no existing Ruff configuration.
